operations.source_name: Building control approval for higher-risk buildings
operations.result: Official guidance defines Building Safety Regulator approval requirements for higher-risk building work, including emergency repairs and staged applications.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Approval guidance is a regulatory contract, not evidence that a specific building is compliant.

operations.source_name: Review of Approved Document B fire safety guidance
operations.result: The 2026 consultation proposes technical changes covering existing buildings, external walls, balconies, evacuation lifts, specialised housing, roofs and car parks.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Consultation proposals are not final requirements and cannot change a parcel score.

operations.source_name: Approved Document B fire safety
operations.result: The statutory guidance covers fire safety matters within and around buildings in England.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Building-level design and inspection evidence is required before local attribution.

operations.source_name: Plan approval requirements for new builds and Fire Safety Order buildings
operations.result: The consultation proposes stronger plan approval procedures for new homes and Fire Safety Order buildings below 18 metres.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: The proposal is not proof of compliance for any candidate location.

operations.source_name: Fire Safety Order enforcement and sanctions
operations.result: The updated guide explains duties, inspecting officer powers, notices, appeals and prosecution under the Fire Safety Order and 2022 regulations.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Enforcement guidance does not identify notices against a specific premises.

operations.source_name: Fire safety guidance for those with legal duties
operations.result: The collection states that responsible persons must assess fire risk and maintain general fire precautions in workplaces and common parts of multi-occupied residential buildings.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Responsible-person duties are not a parcel-level risk observation.

operations.source_name: Actions for residents and owners to keep higher-risk buildings safe
operations.result: Guidance describes resident duties not to interfere with safety equipment or create fire and structural risks in higher-risk buildings.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Resident guidance cannot confirm the condition of a particular building.

operations.source_name: Mandatory occurrence notices and reports
operations.result: Principal designers, contractors and accountable persons must report specified structural-failure or fire-spread incidents and risks to the regulator.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: No occurrence report data for a named candidate was accessed.

operations.source_name: Design and construction of higher-risk buildings
operations.result: The official collection sets out client, designer and contractor duties for higher-risk buildings and reporting safety risks.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: General duties do not establish compliance at an individual property.

operations.source_name: Remediation enforcement guidance for regulators
operations.result: The guidance describes regulator powers where landlords have not remediated unsafe cladding or other fire and structural defects.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: A building-specific enforcement record is needed for candidate attribution.

operations.source_name: Housing Health and Safety Rating System enforcement guidance
operations.result: The 2026 guidance describes the risk-based HHSRS covering 21 potential housing hazards and local authority enforcement for category 1 and category 2 hazards.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: No inspection or HHSRS score for a specific dwelling was accessed.

operations.source_name: Hazardous substances planning guidance
operations.result: Planning authorities are expected to seek COMAH competent-authority advice for development around hazardous installations, pipelines, explosives sites, ports and nuclear sites.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Consultation-zone geometry is required before any candidate can be linked.

operations.source_name: Hazardous substances consent
operations.result: HSE explains that consent assessments produce three risk zones used for consultation on relevant future development.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Risk-zone maps were not retrieved or intersected with candidate geometry.

operations.source_name: London policy on hazardous substances and installations
operations.result: The historic London Plan policy directs boroughs to identify major hazards and apply HSE planning advice near hazardous installations.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: This is a past-plan policy surface and not a current local hazard observation.

operations.source_name: Draft London Plan publication and statutory consultation decision
operations.result: The Mayor approved publication of the Draft London Plan for a 13-week statutory consultation beginning 16 July 2026.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Draft policy is not adopted evidence and cannot alter candidate confidence.

operations.source_name: Draft London Plan consultation
operations.result: The official consultation is open from July to October 2026 and includes supporting evidence for a greener, resilient and healthy city.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Consultation content is contextual and not a parcel observation.

operations.source_name: Report a flood or possible cause of flooding
operations.result: The official service routes reports by source, including sewers, roads, main rivers, reservoirs, groundwater and private drains.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: A reporting route is not evidence that flooding occurred at a candidate.

operations.source_name: Report water pollution in England
operations.result: The service accepts mapped reports of sewage, industrial, agricultural and other water pollution incidents.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: Only a validated incident record with location and time could support local attribution.

operations.source_name: Report an environmental problem
operations.result: The official routing covers water pollution, flooding, river blockages, environmental damage, waste crime and local-authority nuisances.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: The page is a routing service and contains no current candidate-level incident.

operations.source_name: Request flood history for an area
operations.result: The Environment Agency can provide available flood-history information around an English address or postcode, subject to coverage and possible fees.
operations.parcel_attribution_limit: No candidate address request or returned report was available.
